title: Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs Price Schedule: Pack Sizes, Unit Prices and Bonus Units
content:
# Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs — Price Schedule

The Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs are sold to creditor clients as packs of letter units, in six sizes from the First Notice 50-Unit Program to the First Notice 2500-Unit Program. Each pack has a fixed number of purchased units, a fixed price per purchased unit, a number of bonus units added free, and a limit on how many open programs of that same size one client may hold at once.

| Pack | Purchased units | Bonus units | Price per purchased unit (USD) | Open programs of this size per client | Entry threshold: client's monthly new delinquencies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 50 | 0 | 14.95 | 1 | no more than 15 |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 150 | 0 | 12.95 | 1 | no more than 40 |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 300 | 10 | 10.95 | 1 | at least 15 |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 600 | 25 | 8.95 | 1 | at least 30 |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 1200 | 60 | 7.45 | 2 | at least 60 |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 2500 | 150 | 5.95 | 2 | at least 120 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Purchased units** are the letter units bought in the pack. **Bonus units** are units added free with the pack; they are additional to the purchased units and carry no price.
2. **Price per purchased unit** is the price of one unit in that pack, in US dollars.
3. **Open programs of this size per client** is the largest number of open programs of that pack size one client may hold at the same time.
4. The **entry threshold** is each pack's entry gate, stated in the client's monthly new delinquencies: an upper bound for the two smallest packs and a lower bound for the four larger packs.

## Reading the schedule

- The First Notice 50-Unit Program and the First Notice 150-Unit Program include no bonus units; every larger pack does, from 10 bonus units on the 300-unit pack to 150 on the 2500-unit pack.
- The price per purchased unit falls as the pack grows, from 14.95 on the smallest pack to 5.95 on the largest.
- A client may hold up to 2 open programs of the 1200-unit size, and up to 2 of the 2500-unit size, but only 1 open program of each of the four smaller sizes.
